tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul mchog grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul mchog grub ces bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo| |chos kun gdod nas ma grub pa// sgyu ma ji bzhin de las kyang*// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skur ston pa// snying rje'i stobs la bdag phyag 'tshal// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lam nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro// dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su sgrub khang nye bar brgyan pa'i nang du bris 'bur gang yang rung ba'i sgyu ma chen mo'i sku'i mdun du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma sha chang gis sbags shing*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan sogs kyis brgyan pa bshams/ bdag gi mdun du cang te'u/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis la sogs pa nyer mkho tshogs shing bkod legs par bshams/ phyi nang gi khrus bya/ stan bde bar chos thams cad 'od gsal du bcug pas nyal/ nangs par lha mo bzhi'i glus bskul bas sangs par bsam ste/ snga bar langs nas phyag rgya lnga la sogs dang ldan pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i skur gsal bar mos la/ nang mchod a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung dkyil nag po zla khaṃ rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mi'i sha dang byang sems/ shar du glang po'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba glang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rkang mar de dag gi steng du hūm̐ las zla ba'i steng du rdo rje gnas pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ bdud rtsi khol zhing zla ba dang rdo rje 'od du zhu ba thim pas/

lha'i bdud rtsir gyur pa'i steng du oṃ yig dkar po'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu gyur par mos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis lcer bzhag la kha dag par bya/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ k+ṣe tra pā la i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ma ma sa pa ri wā ri/ sarba satwa nāñtsa/ sarba pā paṃ byā ti bigh+nāṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru/ dhā na ka s+ya ā yuḥ a ro ṣ+ya puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru/ sarba bha yaṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ gzhi bdag zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ */mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ */rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'bru nor tshe dpal 'khor rgyas shing*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol zhing rol mo dang bcas gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'od zer gyis bdag sbyang ba dang sgo dag par byas zhing*/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gnas dang bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ rnam pa lha rdzas/ ngo bo stong nyid/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag med kyi bde ba bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin/ ā tsa mā naṃ= puṣ+paṃ= dhū paṃ= ā lo kaṃ= gan+dhaṃ= nai wi d+yaṃ= shapad 'i bar sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim mo/ dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog */las rgyal mchog go// dang po sbyor ba ni/

rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su/ hrīḥyig sngon po las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying gar thim par gyur/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug pa// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sgo gsum gus pas phyag bya/ slar snying ga'i sa bon las mched pa'i lha mo rnams spros nas mchod par gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ reg bya'i lha mos gtso bo la 'khyud nas dga' ba brtsams pas snyoms 'jug gi bde bas lha thams cad tshim par gyur par bsam pa gsang mchod/ de nas/ don dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / ces lan gsum gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/

tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / ces tshangs gnas bzhi bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phan pa dang bde ba'i ched du/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas nas shin tu mthar phyin pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la rab tu 'god par bya ba'i phyir sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lam nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge dkar dmar sngo ba gsal bar gyur/ he ni chos thams cad rgyu dang bral ba/ ha ni chos thams cad 'phel 'grib med pa/ e ni chos thams cad yongs su rtog pa la rnam par grol ba/ ru ni chos thams cad sgra brnyan dang 'dra ba/ ra ni chos thams cad dga' ba dang ldan pa/ u ni chos thams cad skye shi dang bral ba/ ka ni chos thams cad gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ ka ni chos thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa/ a ni chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i sgo'o// zhes yi ge gsum gyi don dran par bya/ bdag dang gzhan la sogs pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid do// oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes stong nyid bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs so| | stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang de yongs su gyur pa las/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ dra ba/ gur dang*/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i dum bu gcig pa sra zhing brtan la gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me ri kha dog sna tshogs bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bur 'bar zhing 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/

srung 'khor gyi nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du shar nas g.yas skor du gtum drag /dbyibs can/ tshang tshing*/ 'bar ba/ mi thod/ mi zad pa/ ha ha rgod pa/ g.yer kha can/ de rnams su rim gyis shar nas/ ro tshigs pa dang*/ ma tshig pa/ dum bur gyur pa/ dum bur ma gyur pa/ 'jig pa/ 'jig par byed pa/ mdung rtser bskyon pa/ sgeg pa rnams gnas shing*/ khwa dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ gtum po'i khyi dang*/ srin po dang*/ phag dang*/ ro langs dang*/ khro ma dang*/ dred khro ma dang*/ gzhan yang dur khrod de rnams su shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa bar phyogs skyong dang rtse mor zhing skyong brgyad brgyad/ chu brgyad la gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad/ sprin brgyad kyi dbus na lha brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad dang*/ ri brgyad la brten pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad la sogs pa dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung dkyil nag po gzhu bdung ba lta bu'i g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su suṃ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can gyi lte bar/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa nang nas nag /dkar/ ser/ dmar/ ljang ba'i rtsig pa lnga sbrags/ rin po che'i pha gu/ dra ba/ dra phyed/ shar bu/ mda' yab/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan la sogs pas mdzes shing*/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du rta babs bzhi dang*/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyi steng du gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris pa'i thog byur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog dang bcas pa/

phyi rol du 'dod snam dmar po la lha mo du mas mchod rdzas thogs pas mchod pa/ gzhal med khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar| byang ljang*/ dbus mthing ga /sgo bzhi'i nang du gser gyi bum pa gnyis gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'od 'phro ba'i mu khyud la rdo rje nag po'i phreng bas bskor ba'i mtshams bzhi'i 'dab ma la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi gnas pa/ lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ gdan dbus mar thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i ye shes byang chub sems kyi thig le mu tig gi mdog ltar 'tsher zhing 'bar ba gsal bar gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ dbus kyi thig le de las thig le dkar po bzhi phyogs bzhi'i nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du spros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du hūm̐ sngon po/ lhor swā ser po/ nub tu āḥdamar po/ byang du hā ljang gu rnams su gyur pa'i hūm̐ yig las rdo rje'i rigs can dang de'i rigs rnams yang dag par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dab ma shar du sa'i khams dang me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas ser/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje sngon po/ gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yon dang pos dril bu/ gnyis pas ka pā la 'dzin pa/ swā yig las rin po che'i rigs can dang de'i rigs rnams yang dag par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ rin chen dbang gi rigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'dab ma lhor chu khams dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal ser po/

zhal lhag ma g.yas sngo/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos rin po che'i snye ma/ gnyis pas rtse gsum la ba dan 'phyang ba/ g.yon dang pos dung chen/ gnyis pas ce spyang gi mgrin pa nas 'dzin pa/ āḥyig las pad+ma'i rigs can dang de'i rigs rnams yang dag par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ gsung gi dbang phyug gi rigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus āḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dab ma nub tu me khams dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal dmar zhing dkar ba'i mdangs ldan/ zhal lhag ma g.yas ser/ rgyab sngo/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos sna tshogs pad+ma/ gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon dang pos bde skyong*/ gnyis pas gzhu bsnams pa/ hā yig las las kyi rigs dang de'i rigs rnams yang dag par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hā la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las| 'dab ma byang du rlung gi khams dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal ljang gu/ zhal lhag ma g.yas ser/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas thod pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon dang pos yi dwags kyi lhung bzed/ gnyis pas zhags pa thogs pa/ de bzhi ka'ang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ zhal rnams cung zad gdangs shing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhing chen gyi stod g.yogs 'chang ba phyag g.yas dang po thugs ka/ g.yon pa gsang ba'i thad/ tha ma gnyis dpung pa'i thad sor brgyangs pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'bar ba'i me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ de nas byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms te/ tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bzhis/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum thig le'i rnam par bzhugs pa mthong ma thag rdo rje sems dpa' bslang ba'i slad du/ kye ma/ gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma kha rab 'byed// a la la la la la hoḥ /bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad+ma'i kha rab 'byed pa bzhin/ a la la la la la hoḥ /bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces zhu ba'i glus bskul bas/ bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse zhing sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yang dag par gzigs te/ thig le'i gzugs bor nas sa bon hrīḥ'am hūm̐ nag po dang oṃ dmar por gyur pa'i oṃ las rnam snang dang de'i rigs rnams yang dag par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus oṃ yig la thim zhing*/ hrīḥ'am hūm̐ yig las rgyal ba lnga dang de'i rigs yang dag pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i go 'phang la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul de rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ hrīḥ'am hūm̐ la thim ma thag oṃ las nam mkha'i khams dang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang lhan cig pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal bung ba'i mdog lta bu/ zhal lhag ma g.yas ser/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon ljang gu/ zhal bzhi lha mo bzhi la gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis rol pa bcas pas mda' gzhu 'gengs shing*/

g.yas 'og ma khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ g.yon 'og ma dril bu dang g.yer kha 'phyang ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ cung zad khros pa'i spyan bcu gnyis dmar zhing zlum pa/ zhal gdangs pa'i mche ba bcu drug gtsigs shing bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba/ mi rus kyi 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ ska rags te/ phyag rgya lnga'i steng du yan lag thams cad thal chen gyis byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal 'phyang ba/ mi lpags rlon pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i brla'i rtsa bar g.yon bskum pa'i mthil gtad pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'gyings pa/ 'od zer bye ba'i tshogs spros pas 'gro ba rnams la phan par bya ba'i phyir mdzad pa mdzad cing 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ de'i pang du rang snang gi yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal ser/ rgyab zhal dkar/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ phyag dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis thod pa dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa rnam snang gi cod pan can thod skam lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras shing gcer bu mgo'i phreng ba dang bral ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥdamar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ra nag po/

zhes go cha'i yi ge drug dang*/ slar yang*/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ yab kyi nu ma'i bar du ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ hrīḥ'am hūm̐ yig nag po 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyu glog gi zhags pa lta bu phyogs bcur spros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ hūm̐ zhes phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ phyag rgya bzhi dang bcas pas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbang du byas pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du 'dres| slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha rgyal ba yab yum sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo ste/ gdan gsum tshang ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mchod yon dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad de/ thugs ka nas rig ma chu shel lta bu'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa spros pa rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu'i rgyun gyis gang*/ sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mar rnam snang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin chen dbang*| pad+ma mkha' 'gro la gsung gi dbang phyug /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/

dbang gi lha rnams rang la thim par gyur par bsam/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa nam mkha'i khams gang bas he ru ka lha mo bzhi dang bcas pa la mchod par gyur/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ lha mo lngas gtso bo la bstod par mos la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs chen po// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen po ni gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal| | zhes bstod/ de nas/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar āḥ gsang gnas su swā/ brla gnyis nas rkang pa la thug gi bar du hā rnams gsal ba| de rnams gcig la gcig 'phros pas lus thams cad rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyis khyab par gyur par mos/ slar yum gyi mkha' hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po bh+rūṃ las skyes pa'i ge sar ser po can du bsam la/ lha mo bzhis sngar ltar zhu ba'i glus bskul bas/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bus mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par gyur/ yab kyis yum la 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa'i byed pa sna tshogs pas rjes su chags pa brtsams te/ a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyod pa'i phaṭa kyi sgras rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ yab kyi khar bcug zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas byung yum gyi pad+mar bab pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pa/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las 'od kyi rdo rje'i rnam pa can phra mo'i sbu gus drangs te gsol bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pas mnyes tshim rangs par gyur par bsam/ gsum pa las rgyal mchog ni/ thog mar de ltar bsgoms nas dag pa dran pa ni/ sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// gtso bo bcom ldan sgyu 'phrul che// chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog gnag /rnam thar bzhi ldan zhal bzhi pa// dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum gsum| |gnyis med ye shes 'bar ba'i skra// ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i thod// nyon mongs kun gcod mche ba gtsigs// bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ni phyag

/spro bsdu'i shes rab rno ba mda'| |zag med bde skyong ka pā la// snying brtse'i thugs can bdag nyid gzhu// rnam kun stong nyid kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /phar phyin drug dag phyag rgya drug /thugs rje che ldan dung chen phreng*// thabs shes zung 'jug zhabs gnyis ldan// mkha' dang rnam shes rnam dag pa// chos dbyings sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma// sa khams gzugs phung rnam dag pa// me long rdo rje mkha' 'gror brjod// chu khams tshor phung rnam dag pa// mnyam nyid rin chen mkha' 'gror grags// me khams 'du shes rnam dag pa// sor rtog pad+ma mkha' 'gror dran// rlung khams 'du byed rnam dag pa// nan tan sna tshogs mkha' 'gro nyid// ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje ste// rgyal ba'i yon tan rdzogs rin chen// 'gro kun don mdzad pad+ma ste// log lta gcod pas ral gri nyid// chos bdag med pa'i sgra dril bu// sku gsum bdag nyid mdung rtse gsum// 'gro kun 'dul phyir dzam+bu ka /stong nyid sgra sgrog cang te'u// nyon mongs kun 'ching zhags pa nyid// shes rab dang ni snying rje yis// gzhan don mdzad phyir skyil mo krung*// phyed bcas rdo rje'i gar gyis bsgyings// zhes rnam dag dran par bya/ de nas rang dang mkha' 'gro ma lnga las rang 'dra'i rigs can gyi sku mtha' yas pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang*/ phung po dang*/ khams kyi tshogs ma lus pa sbyangs/ ye shes lnga mngon du byas shing*/ rgyal ba lnga dang*/ yum lnga/ rdo rje 'chang chen po dang bcas pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang rang gi sku la thim par yun ring du bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas srung 'khor dur khrod la thim/ dur khrod gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang lha mo bzhi la/ lha mo bzhi yum gyi zhal bzhi la/ yum yab la thim/ yab kyi thugs kar āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/

de'i lte bar gsang bar gnas pa'i sa rlung dang*/ snying gar gnas pa'i chu rlung gnyis rnam par dag pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang rin chen mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi rang bzhin/ de'i steng du rang rig pa'i ngo bo sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rang bzhin 'od kyi thig le yungs 'bru tsam 'od lnga 'bar ba/ de'i steng du mgrin par gnas pa'i me rlung dang spyi bor gnas pa'i rlung gi rlung gnyis rnam par dag pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de ni pad+ma mkha' 'gro dang sna tshogs mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi rang bzhin/ de ltar nyi zla kha sbyar bar mtshams med pa'i dbus kyi thig le las 'od zer pad+ma'i srad bu lta bu 'phros pa/ steng gi zla bar bug pa yungs 'bru tsam yod pa las thon te 'od kyi srad bu de nyid mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i phreng ba gnyis ldab kyi rnam pas zla nyi kha sbyor gyi phyir phyed dang bcas pa'i lan bdun du dkris pa/ thig le las 'od zer sgra dang bcas pa steng gi zla ba'i bu ga nas thon/ sna bug gi rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstun dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig phyed bcas bdun du dkris nas bug par zhugs thig le la thim/ rlung nang du gnas tshe thig le la sems gtad/ srog rtsol gi rlung cung zad bsdams la bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob pa'i rtags 'od zer gyi ri mo gsal bar snang ba dang*/ sna tshogs pa'i stong gzugs gsal bar snang ba skyu ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar mthong*/ de ni thig le'i rnal 'byor zhes bya'o// yang rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe oṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pa nang du rngub pa na āḥ'i rang bzhin du bcug /gnas pa hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du thig le la thim zhing*/ thig le dkar po la sems gtad nas bsgom pa ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste/ de ltar yang yang bsgoms pas gyen rgyu dang thur sel gyi rlung rim pa ji lta bar 'gog cing*/

de bzhin du mtshan ma rnams rim gyis skye bar 'gyur te/ gsang ba'i sa rlung snying ga'i chu rlung la thim pas ni kun nas mnyam pa'i blos zag pa med pa'i lam gyi ye shes dang po skye/ snying ga'i chu rlung mgrin pa'i me rlung la thim pas ni sems la dbang thob ste du ba lta bu'i rtags snang mthong*/ mgrin pa'i me rlung spyi bo'i rlung gi rlung la thim pas ni ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig dang ldan te glog gi rnam pa lta bur mthong*/ spyi bo'i rlung gi rlung rnam par rig pa la thim pas 'dod pa thams cad dang bral te mar me lta bur mthong*/ rnam par rig pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bde ba la thim pas thams cad snang ba'i rig pa nam mkha' lta bur mthong*/ rang rig pa sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bus smon lam dang snying rje chen po'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis su snang bar 'gyur ste/ ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du'o// zhes pa ni/ slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i mā yā'i sgrub thabs rmongs pa grol ba'i brtag pa rdo rje'i stobs bsgoms par byas nas/ mgo bo dang*/ snying ga dang*/ lte ba dang*/ gsang bar rlung dang*/ sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me'i dkyil 'khor man ngag ji lta ba bzhin bsgom par bya/ ma ning gi 'dzab oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzla'o// zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag ji lta ba zhes pa'i don mā yā'i rdzogs rim slob dpon chos kyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ 'di dag ni shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs rim yin pas chags grol gnyis ka'i lam gyi rtsa ba spyir med ka med du snang zhing*/ bye brag chags lam pas 'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ grol lam pas steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor yang tha dad du bsgom par bya ba yin no// de ltar 'bad pas ngal na sngags bzla ba ni/ spros pa la dga' na sngar ltar/ rang sgyu 'phrul chen mor gsal ba'i spyi mgrin snying gar he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge dkar dmar sngo ba gsal bar gyur/

ces pa nas/ tshur 'dus rang rang gi sku la thim par yun ring du bsgom mo// zhes pa'i bar yongs rdzogs sam/ mi spro na/ yum dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi skad cig gis gsal btab la/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis zlum por g.yas su bskor ba/ sa bon nga ro med pa rnams kyi mgor thig les mtshan pa/ sngags kyi oṃ zhes brjod pa'i tshe thig le las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad snang bar byas nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod/ rang sngags brjod pa na sangs rgyas de'ang rang gi lha'i rang bzhin du byas/ sngags mtha'i hūm̐ zhes brjod pa na sangs rgyas su byas pa'i 'gro ba de rnams tshur bsdus thig le la thim par bsam/ de tsam mi nus na/ sa bon mi 'gul bar sngags 'phreng drag la myur ba g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer dang sngags kyi sgras don gnyis byas 'dus par bsam yang rung ngo*// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ slob dpon rgyan pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa gtso bo'i sngags so// oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ yum gyi'o// oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes pa mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i'o// yang slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba dang*/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis ni/ oṃ hrīḥ'am hūm̐ hūm̐/ gtso bo'o// oṃ oṃ hūm̐/ yum gyi'o| | oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ swā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hā hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i'o// de yang sngags tshan gong ma lnga ni sgrub thabs rmongs pa grol ba'i brtag par rtsa sngags yin par gsungs/ yang*/ slob dpon sku med rdo rje'i sgrub thabs su ni/ gtso bo'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa/ ces gsungs nas yum dang 'khor gyi sngags ma gsungs so// de ltar sngags bzla ba'i tshe/

lha rnams kyi zhal thams cad nas sngags zlo bar bsam/ dung chen gyi phreng ba la byin rlabs byas par bgrang*| bgrang rtags ni/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhabs kyi mā yā'i sgrub thabs su/ de ltar nyin dang mtshan du ji srid dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ma rnyed pa de srid du bya'o// zhes gtso bor rtags kyi bsnyen pa gsungs la/ grangs kyang de nyid du| de la dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po'i sngags ni 'bum bzlas pas 'grub bo// lhag ma ni khri bzlas pas so// phreng ba'i sngags ni rgyud gzhan nas blang bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ni yid bskyed rim las gang du'ang mi 'phro ba'i bzlas pa la dgongs kyi/ deng sang de tsam dka' bas gtso bo la 'bru 'bum/ yang na gtso bo la bye ba phrag gsum/ 'bum bzhi/ yum gyi sngags la 'bum gsum mam bye ba gcig /'khor sngags rnams 'bum phrag re re/ slob dpon gyi khur ldan yin na dkyil chog tu bshad pa'i ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags 'bum mam khri/ bzlas pa'i bcu cha sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs pa ni/ zhi ba las thams cad pa'i thab tu rdzas gzhan rnams ci tsam 'byor ba 'bul zhing*/ bcu cha'i grangs ni til nyid la byas na legs par sems so// sku med rdo rjes gtso bo'i sngags ni ji tsam rung ba bzlas kyang legs ma bzlas kyang med mi rung du mi 'gyur/ sngar slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i lung gis/ phreng sngags rgyud gzhan nas blang bar gsungs pa ni/ ma rgyud nang mthun gang yang rung ba'am/ khyad par nang tshan gyi rigs mā yā dang mthun pa gang rung gi phreng sngags blang ba la dgongs sam snyam/ bzlas pa'i dus kyang slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas yid kyis brjod par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ bzlas pa'i skyon drug spangs te yid kyis bzla bar bya'o// gsum pa rjes 'dzin ni/ bzlas pas skyo na/ sngar ltar phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod la/

rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul bas dkyil 'khor pa rnams rang gi snying gar bsdus/ sems can gyi don du/ bdag gis rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yi// bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i khyab bdag gi// gtso bo'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces smon lam gdab/ mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su bzhag /slar yang ldang ba'i tshe/ rang nyid he ru ka rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur par mos/ dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya zhing*/ bya ba gang byed kyang rang gi phung khams skye mched kyi rang gi ngo bo/ khams gsum po ni sgyu ma/ rmi lam/ smig rgyu/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bur rang gi sems dang tha mi dad pa'i rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba phyi nang gi gzugs la rnal 'byor pas bsam mo// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i 'jig 'das kyi gtor ma gnyis la chu chang dang bdud rtsi bran/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/

rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ gtor mgron sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs mtha' yas pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ gtor mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rtse las 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi'i gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsam/ rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra ā kaṭ+ṭa ya ā kaṭ+ṭa ya/ pra we sha ya pra we sha ya/ bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya| to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī naṃ hṛ da yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum dang*/ slar/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ swā phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ āḥphaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hā phaṭa/ oṃ sarba yo gi ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tshe maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ ha ha ha hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis dkyil 'khor pa la gtor ma phul nas/ 'jig dus chu 'dzin mdog can brgyad phyed zhal// phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis bdud kyi snying gar mnan| |rang rig 'od kyis 'khril zhing bdes gang ba// bde gshegs kun gtso rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams dag cing*// ye shes lnga ldan mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga| |sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// sna tshogs rigs can rnams la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces bstod/ 'jig rten pa rnams la rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ k+ṣe tra pā la nas/ swā hā 'i bar sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i skabs ltar lan gsum dang*/

slar/ oṃ kha kha khā hi nas/ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā 'i bar gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ he ru ka dpal yab yum ni// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas// zhing skyong brgyad dang phyogs skyong bcu// dur khrod gnas pa'i ma mo sogs// 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod kyi bar brjod/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// nas/ skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes pa'i bar gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la chos bshad/ mchod cing bstod nas/ yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su dengs/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs| dam tshig pa rnams mi dmigs par gyur par bsam/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying gar lte ba'i me sbar ba'i dbus su snying gar sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gi gsal zhing kha thab khung*/ lag gnyis dgang blugs thabs shes mnyam rol gyi phyag rgyas phul bas lha rnams tshim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu h+ya bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣe haṃ/ zhes brjod cing longs spyad/ khrus ni sngar dbang bskur ba'i skabs ltar bya/ nyal ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad snang ba med pa'i 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe/ lha mo bzhis tshad med bzhi'i glu cang te'u dang dril bu'i sgras bskul bar bsam la ldang*/ de yang sngar bshad pa'i cho ga sngon 'gro nas bsdu rim gyi bar yongs su rdzogs par bya/ thun las langs nas bza' ba'i tshe kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ltar longs spyod cing*/

khrus bya ba ni thun dang por bya'o// thun gnyis par ni dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs la rang lhar gsal ba'i snying ga'i sa bon las rten gyi dkyil 'khor sprul/ slar sa bon de nyid las rnal 'byor ma bzhi spros phyogs bzhir bkod/ de la dbang bskur ba nas bsdu rim gyi bar snga ma ltar bya/ thun gsum pa dang bzhi pa la'ang thun gnyis pa kho na ltar bya/ thun so so'i mthar kha zas za na bza' ba'i rnal 'byor ltar longs spyad/ thun bzhi ka'i mthar grub na 'jig 'das kyi gtor ma'ang gtang*/ de ltar ma grub na thun tha ma nyal khar gtor ma nges par btang la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldang*/ de'ang thun gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa sogs la ni bshad ma thag pa ltar srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha mo bzhi dang bcas pa snying ga nas skad cig la sprul pa tsam ma gtogs mngon rtogs rgyas pa mi dgos pa yin/ thun thams cad kyi mthar/ bdag gis rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yi// bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i khyab bdag gi// gtso bo'i go 'phang myur thob shog | ces dang*/ gang zhig bdag byas bsod nams kyis// rdo rje mkha' 'gro sgom gyur cig /de yis rdo rje mkha' 'gros bdag /'gro kun phun tshogs thob gyur cig / ces sogs smon lam rnam dag gdab bo// sgyu 'phrul sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul mchog grub 'di// sgyu 'phrul mnga' brnyes rgyan pa'i gsung ji bzhin// sgyu 'phrul sgrub thabs 'di byas dge ba'i mthus// sgyu 'phrul go 'phang kun gyis myur thob shog /de ltar sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul mchog grub ces bya ba 'di yang rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i grub chen ku ku ri pa zhes sam/ mtshan gzhan slob dpon rgyan pa zhes pas mdzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi sgrub thabs rmongs pa grol ba'i brtag pa nyid gtsor bzhag

/de nyid la dgos nges kyi kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung dang*/ slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhabs dang*/ sku med rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs rnams kyis legs par bskangs shing*/ rdzogs rim yang sgrub thabs rmongs pa grol ba'i brtag par tho tsam gsungs pa slob dpon chos kyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa sor bzhag pa yin la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su ni gtso bo sngon la bskyed pa dang*/ de'ang glu lhag ma can gyi rim pas zla nyi dbyangs gsal gyi bar du thig le sogs mngon byang lnga bskyed mdzad pa sogs sgrub thabs gzhan rnams dang 'dra min cher 'dug pa'ang dgos gnas su bris pa ste 'di yang*/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas shing bya gro bzhin zla ba'i dmar po'i dga' ba gsum pa la pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig pad+ma 'od du rgya gzhung sor bzhag la/ rje zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa dang*/ bu ston zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi tshig sbyor cung zad bskangs te sbyar ba las gzhan pa'i rang bzo dang bod mā'i bsre lhad spu tsam med do// //maṅga laṃ//
